mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine (a prodrug of dexamphetamine) combined with morphine increases CNS depression risk while amphetamine stimulant effects may mask opioid-induced respiratory depression, creating a dangerous combination of opposing CNS effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest effective doses with careful monitoring of respiratory function, sedation levels, and cardiac status, and counsel patients on overdose risks.
